name: @pipeworx/mcp-euipo

tools.name: euipo_search_trademarks
tools.description: Search EU trademarks (EUTM) at the EUIPO — "find EU trademarks containing NIKE in Nice classes 9 and 25". Use for EU brand clearance and competitor trademark portfolios. Returns matching marks (application number, mark text, status, owner, Nice classes, filing date) plus raw. Example: euipo_search_trademarks({ verbal_element: "nike", nice_classes: [9, 25], status: "REGISTERED", _apiKey: "client_id:client_secret" })

verbal_element.description: Text/word element of the mark to match (wildcards added automatically), e.g. "nike". Multi-word values are quoted safely.

applicant.description: Applicant / owner name to match, e.g. "Nike Innovate".

nice_classes.description: Nice classification classes to filter by, e.g. [9, 25].

status.description: Trademark status filter, e.g. "REGISTERED", "APPLICATION_FILED", "EXPIRED". Comma-separate for multiple.

query.description: Advanced: raw RSQL filter passed through verbatim (e.g. verbalElement=="*nike*";niceClasses=in=(9,25)). Overrides the friendly params above.

_apiKey.description: EUIPO OAuth credentials as "client_id:client_secret" from dev.euipo.europa.eu.

tools.name: euipo_trademark
tools.description: Retrieve a single EU trademark by its application or registration number from the EUIPO — "look up EUTM 018123456". Returns the full record (mark text, status, owner/representative, Nice classes, goods & services, filing/registration/expiry dates) plus raw. Example: euipo_trademark({ number: "018123456", _apiKey: "client_id:client_secret" })

number.description: EUTM application or registration number, e.g. "018123456".

_apiKey.description: EUIPO OAuth credentials as "client_id:client_secret" from dev.euipo.europa.eu.

tools.name: euipo_search_designs
tools.description: Search registered Community designs (RCD) at the EUIPO — "find registered EU designs owned by Adidas in Locarno class 02". Use for design-filing landscape and competitor design portfolios. Returns matching designs (design number, indication of product, status, owner, Locarno classes, filing date) plus raw. Example: euipo_search_designs({ owner: "adidas", locarno_classes: ["02"], _apiKey: "client_id:client_secret" })

indication.description: Indication of product / design keyword to match (wildcards added automatically), e.g. "footwear".

owner.description: Design owner / applicant name to match, e.g. "adidas".

locarno_classes.description: Locarno classification classes to filter by, e.g. ["02", "09"].

status.description: Design status filter, e.g. "REGISTERED", "EXPIRED". Comma-separate for multiple.

query.description: Advanced: raw RSQL filter passed through verbatim (e.g. indicationOfProduct=="*footwear*";locarnoClasses=in=(02)). Overrides the friendly params above.

_apiKey.description: EUIPO OAuth credentials as "client_id:client_secret" from dev.euipo.europa.eu.

tools.name: euipo_search_goods_services
tools.description: Explore the EUIPO's harmonised Nice goods-and-services classification (TMClass) — "find accepted goods-and-services terms for 'software' in Nice class 9". Use when preparing a trademark filing or checking whether a term is already a recognised, pre-classified term. Returns matching terms with their Nice class and concept id, plus raw. Example: euipo_search_goods_services({ term: "software", nice_class: 9, language: "en", _apiKey: "client_id:client_secret" })

term.description: Text to search for within goods-and-services terms, e.g. "software".

nice_class.description: Nice classification class number(s) to restrict the search to, e.g. [9] or [9, 42]. Also accepts a single integer.

language.description: EU official language code for the search and results, e.g. "en", "es", "de", "fr". Required by the upstream API; defaults to "en".

parent_concept_id.description: Restrict to children of this taxonomy concept id (for browsing the classification tree).

include_term_variants.description: Include term variants in the results (default false).

_apiKey.description: EUIPO OAuth credentials as "client_id:client_secret" from dev.euipo.europa.eu.

tools.name: euipo_validate_goods_services
tools.description: Validate a list of goods-and-services terms against the EUIPO's harmonised database (TMClass) — checks whether each term is a recognised ("harmonized") term, and flags invalid characters, duplicates, forbidden terms, and length problems. Use before filing to catch terms an examiner would object to. Returns per-term accepted/not-accepted status plus raw. Example: euipo_validate_goods_services({ terms: ["computer software", "C@ts and dog$"], nice_class: 9, language: "en", _apiKey: "client_id:client_secret" })

terms.description: Goods-and-services terms to validate, e.g. ["computer software", "downloadable mobile applications"].

nice_class.description: Nice classification class the terms belong to, e.g. 9. The upstream validates terms per class.

language.description: Language the terms are written in, e.g. "en". Required by the upstream API; defaults to "en".

_apiKey.description: EUIPO OAuth credentials as "client_id:client_secret" from dev.euipo.europa.eu.

tools.name: euipo_search_product_indications
tools.description: Search the EUIPO's harmonised Locarno product-indications classification (DSClass) used for registered Community design filings — "find accepted design indications for 'chair'". Returns matching indications with their Locarno class/subclass and concept id, plus raw. Example: euipo_search_product_indications({ term: "chair", locarno_class: 6, language: "en", _apiKey: "client_id:client_secret" })

term.description: Text to search for within product-indication terms, e.g. "chair".

locarno_class.description: Locarno classification class number to restrict the search to, e.g. 6.

language.description: EU official language code for the search and results, e.g. "en". Required by the upstream API; defaults to "en".

parent_concept_id.description: Restrict to children of this taxonomy concept id (for browsing the classification tree).

_apiKey.description: EUIPO OAuth credentials as "client_id:client_secret" from dev.euipo.europa.eu.

tools.name: euipo_search_persons
tools.description: Search applicants or representatives on record with the EUIPO for trademark/design procedures — "find the EUIPO representative record for a named law firm". Each row carries its role (e.g. APPLICANT_BUSINESS, APPLICANT_INDIVIDUAL, REPRESENTATIVE_EUIPO_PROFESSIONAL) and its source. Privacy: street/city/postal-code address details are withheld for individual persons — only country-level location is kept; business/association entities keep their registered address. Example: euipo_search_persons({ name: "adidas", role: "applicant", country: "DE", _apiKey: "client_id:client_secret" })

name.description: Name to search for, e.g. "adidas" or a representative's firm/individual name.

role.description: Which EUIPO person register to search: "applicant" (default) or "representative".

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code to filter by, e.g. "DE", "US".

city.description: City to filter by, e.g. "Alicante". Only meaningful for business/association entities (withheld for individuals in the response).

_apiKey.description: EUIPO OAuth credentials as "client_id:client_secret" from dev.euipo.europa.eu.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-euipo forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the euipo pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
